description: Markdown + 目录驱动的人/智能体共用看板

scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build
scripts.dev:stop: for P in 38411 38511; do lsof -tiTCP:$P -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 1; for P in 38411 38511; do lsof -tiTCP:$P -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; true
scripts.stop: P=${PORT:-38311}; lsof -tiTCP:$P -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; lsof -tiTCP:$P -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.restart:all: npm run stop && npm run build:all && npm run start
